LanguageData.BWT_ruleName_Desc: A name to make it easier to tell what a rule does.
LanguageData.BWT_priority_Desc: The priority to set the work type to. (Vanilla always assigns 3.)
LanguageData.BWT_worktype_Desc: If assigned, this will be the only work type this rule applies to.
LanguageData.BWT_allowOverwritingHigherPriority_Desc: By default the highest priority is kept. This allows later rules to overwrite higher priority.
LanguageData.BWT_hasHighestSkill_Desc: Only assign if this pawn has the highest skill. Applies to multiple pawns if tied. (Vanilla assigns one random starting pawn to every work type.)
LanguageData.BWT_skipIfAnotherPawnAssigned_Desc: If another pawn is assigned, do not apply to the current pawn.
LanguageData.BWT_isPregnant_Desc: Only apply if the pawn is pregnant.
LanguageData.BWT_isCapableOfViolence_Desc: Only apply if the pawn is capable of violence.
LanguageData.BWT_assignToPawnWithFewestWorkPriorities: Only assign to the pawn who has the fewest assigned priorities. Applies to multiple if tied. (This needs to be double checked).
LanguageData.BWT_hasChildOnMap_Desc: Only apply if the pawn has a child of learning age on the map.
LanguageData.BWT_isNaturalAlwaysAssign_Desc: Only assign if Vanilla tags the work type as an "always assign" work type. (Vanilla always assigns these.)
LanguageData.BWT_randomIfMultiple_Desc: If multiple pawns were assigned the work type, choose one at random to assign.
LanguageData.BWT_worktypeDefNameIgnoreIfNonexistant_D: This is intended for use with modded work types. It is the same as 'Target work type' but uses a defName instead of a Def. Backend logic stuff. I'm going to need to redo the menu to account for modded work types showing up in the 'Target work type' dropdown.
LanguageData.BWT_isTopXSkill_Desc: Only assign if the work type is one of the pawn's top X skills. (Vanilla automatically assigns the top 6 skills.)
LanguageData.BWT_isNthBestPawn_Desc: Only assign if the pawn is Nth best at this work type. It must be exact.
LanguageData.BWT_isNthBestSkill_Desc: Only assign if the work type is this pawn's Nth best skill. It must be exact.
LanguageData.BWT_limitNumberOfWorktypes_Desc: Only assign if the pawn DOES NOT already have this many work types assigned.
LanguageData.BWT_skipIfPriorityForThisWorktypeAreadyA: Only assign if this work type has not already been assigned. This may be exactly the same as skipIfAnotherPawnAssigned.
LanguageData.BWT_passionLevel_Desc: Only assign if the pawn's passion level for the worktype is exactly this number.
LanguageData.BWT_skillLevelGreaterThan_Desc: Only assign if the pawn's skill in the worktype is greater than this number. (Vanilla assigns skills greater than 5 to starting pawns.)
LanguageData.BWT_skillLevelLessThan_Desc: Only assign if the pawn's skill in the worktype is less than this number.
